rationale: The plan matches the reference: it rejects DESeq2/edgeR/voom because only log2(TPM+1) values exist, runs a value-range check before the model, and applies limma-trend (eBayes trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) directly on the delivered matrix with no re-normalization, no second log, and no pseudo-count conversion. QC precedes the test with PCA/MDS on top 500 genes, distance heatmap, per-sample distributions coloured by condition, and a flag-not-remove outlier policy carried into a with/without sensitivity report. The design (~0 + condition, control as reference, treated - control contrast) is explicit, BH at 0.05 is stated, and any FC threshold is tested via treat() rather than post hoc; enrichment is correctly omitted as unasked. The filter floor is justified as label-independent and sample-count based but its actual value is left to be read from the distribution, a minor vagueness; the report lists method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_de, sessionInfo and the design caveats.
